final: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), shares AS (SELECT telescope_count, 1.0 * telescope_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share FROM status_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(shares.telescope_count) AS total_telescopes, AVG(shares.share) AS average_share, AVG(shares.share - average_share.share) AS average_above_overall_share FROM shares CROSS JOIN average_share WHERE shares.share > average_share.share
